raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Pipeline-parallel HiCache prefetch needs a common storage result before native scheduling can consume it. Background completion collectives couple PP stages to each other's I/O progress, while stopping a fetch before its agreed ACK arrives can finalize a stale prefix.

This change shares the storage query and moves PP completion agreement into the existing scheduler loop. Native request ownership, cache allocation, stop policies, prefix insertion and H2D remain responsible for admitting and executing requests.

## Modifications

- Bind each cache-mode operation to a shared query ticket at native prefetch submission, after grammar and skip checks. PP0 submits the query; existing query collectives agree the storage-only root endpoint and component results. Local L1/L2 coverage is excluded from this MIN.
- Preserve ordered query delivery, including cancellation, and identify retries by the native request handle and attempt counter. Resolve the agreed root result to each stage's local suffix before native allocation and GET.
- Keep TP/CP completion reduction in the worker. Fold available ACKs through PP0 -> PP-last -> PP0 in the PP loop, using the existing P2P helpers with a distinct message tag. Slow stages shorten the proposed batch instead of waiting for local I/O.
- Preserve operation ownership until the ordered query drain or agreed terminal ACK retires it. For cache-mode PP, best_effort requires positive agreed progress before requesting stop. A stopped candidate pauses selection until settlement so later requests are not stopped before its token/chunk budget is charged. Timeout retains its deadline; wait_complete retains natural completion.
- Fence late results across reset/detach with a storage generation. Reuse native component descriptors, buffer publication and release paths, including SWA/Mamba endpoint requirements.

The implementation uses native PP/HiCache/L3 configuration and has no separate admission opt-in flag, prefix lease or capacity-credit protocol. It retains native PP0-led L2/cache-event ordering and its assumptions. Although the completion hook is installed in unified, PD Prefill and PD Decode loops, PD Decode + PP + L3 is not qualified: the native PP decode loop does not drain HiCache events.

## Accuracy Tests

Merged community main at `449617bc94a5d4ae23ad62d0da2f842e711ca983`. Validation of commit `10c7b2e6903a6e9b567e02a33dc4e1b74bdc1b8e`:

- **70 tests passed across seven CPU/Gloo suites**, rerun in separate processes using Python 3.12.3 / Torch 2.13.0 in the existing v0.5.21-cu130 image with the exact source snapshot mounted read-only. Coverage includes decode cache handling, grammar admission, held-row selection, idle progress, shared-query ordering/retries, prefetch lifecycle and real TP2PP3 completion transport.
- Slow-stage ACK availability and reset fencing are checked in the real TP2PP3 ring. Prefill and Decode share submission assertions covering regular/EAGLE keys, the confirmed L3 hit boundary, retry identity and component descriptors. STOP ownership, cancellation and scheduler ordering remain covered.
- The test consolidation changes five test files; production code is unchanged. Full repository pre-commit checks for those files, plus Ruff, isort, syntax and diff whitespace checks passed.
- The image's parameterized package was supplied from a temporary test-only directory. No serving environment or GPU deployment was changed.

GPU end-to-end and model-accuracy acceptance for the current head remain pending.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

GPU/performance validation of the latest stop-boundary change remains pending. The previous admission-gate accuracy and performance tables do not validate this completion-consensus implementation; no speedup claim is made for the current head.

## Checklist

- [x] Add unit and distributed regression coverage.
- [x] Check changed Python syntax and git diff --check before publication.
- [ ] Complete repository CI on the current head.
- [ ] Update user-facing documentation.
- [ ] Complete GPU accuracy and comparable performance validation on the current head.

+Query still uses the controller's background collective. Completion only uses

+from dataclasses import dataclass

+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist

+class PrefetchResult:
+    """Wire data only; each rank keeps its own native operation and buffers."""

+    completed_tokens: int | None
+    pool_hits: dict[str, int] | None
+    completed_req: bool | None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_ack(cls, ack):
+        return cls(ack.completed_tokens, ack.pool_hits, ack.completed_req)
+
+    def fold(self, ack):
+        # Query/allocation and the IO loop already establish ACK order and kind,
+        # including the final ACK after local IO has stopped touching buffers.
+        return PrefetchResult(
+            min(self.completed_tokens, ack.completed_tokens)
+            if self.completed_tokens is not None
+            else None,
+            {
+                pool: min(self.pool_hits.get(pool, 0), ack.pool_hits.get(pool, 0))
+                for pool in self.pool_hits.keys() | ack.pool_hits.keys()
+            }
+            if self.pool_hits is not None
+            else None,
+            self.completed_req,
+        )

+    proposed: tuple[PrefetchResult, ...] | None = None
+    # Native storage reset/detach can overtake already-sent numeric results.
+    generation: int = 0
+
+
+class PPPrefetchConsensus:
+    def __init__(self, controller):
+        self.controller = controller
+        self.rank = dist.get_rank(controller.pp_group)
+        self.pending = deque()
+        self.inflight = False
+        self.tick = 0
+        self.send_work = deque()
+        self.generation = 0

+        """
+        cc = self.controller

+        self.generation += 1

+    def _drain_local(self):

+        count = torch.tensor(cc.pp_prefetch_ack_queue.qsize(), dtype=torch.int)

+            if cc.attn_cp_group is not None or cc.attn_tp_group is not None
+            else (cc.tp_group,)
+        )

+        for group in groups:
+            if group is not None and dist.get_world_size(group) > 1:

+            self.pending.append(cc.pp_prefetch_ack_queue.get_nowait())

+        for result in results:
+            ack = self.pending.popleft()
+            ack.completed_tokens = result.completed_tokens
+            ack.pool_hits = result.pool_hits
+            self.controller._publish_prefetch_ack(ack)

+        PP0 receives the return from pp_loop_size beats ago, after the native
+        pipeline has needed that beat's output, never the current fold.
+        Peers truncate a proposal to their currently available ACKs;

+        native cache-event drain on every stage, preserving its PP0-led order.

+            update = PrefetchUpdate(committed, proposed, self.generation)

+            update = receive()
+            if update.generation != self.generation:
+                update = PrefetchUpdate(generation=update.generation)
+            else:
+                self._publish(update.committed)
+            if update.proposed is not None:
+                update = PrefetchUpdate(
+                    update.committed,
+                    tuple(p.fold(a) for p, a in zip(update.proposed, self.pending)),
+                    update.generation,

+        # In particular, the last stage must not wait for PP0 to receive the
+        # preceding return before it can compute the next microbatch.
+        if len(self.send_work) == return_delay:
+            for work in self.send_work.popleft():
